args: Analyze the root cause and safest minimal fix for TLVRecordReader::getNextTLVRecord in PcapPlusPlus/Packet++/header/TLVData.h, especially malformed records whose getTotalSize() exceeds the remaining TLV data. Identify related methods/invariants and whether getFirstTLVRecord or other APIs have similar unsafe behavior.

The supplied ASan report shows NflogLayer parsing a malformed NflogTlv. The current TLV has recordLen 0x3200 and aligned getTotalSize() 12800 while only about 50 bytes remain. In getNextTLVRecord, a size_t expression used for canAssign underflows, then recordBase + recordSize is assigned and getTotalSize() dereferences an OOB pointer. We need patch only C/C++ under PcapPlusPlus, preserve behavior, and validate offsets/sizes using subtraction before pointer construction/dereference.
